title: Mysterious Mushrooms
body:
Description

Mysterious Mushrooms are a type of Mushroom found in Uncertainty Cave (Inside Desert Canyons). They are found scattered on the ceiling of the cave. These mushrooms shoot projectiles toward players who come close to them. The projectiles themselves do little damage; since there are many of these mushrooms in the cave, however, the collective damage received is considerable. Note that the mushrooms can't shoot projectiles without their cap, albeit chopped down caps don't shoot projectiles.

When a player is hit by a Mysterious Mushroom's projectile, the player is launched upwards. This allows the player to reach the anti-gravity zone, where the player can cut Mysterious Mushrooms down from the cave ceiling. While in the anti-gravity zone, the player can "swim" or float in the air.

Mysterious Mushroom wood can take 3 to 4 hits using the Tall Refined Axe. Depending on the size, the mushroom can yield anywhere from $2,000 upward to $6,000. With recent update (as of the date of this edit), every tree can have various size, and Mysterious Mushroom's cap can get to $9,000 a cap at rare chance (!)

Quest Information

For the special quest in obtaining the Uncertain Pickaxe, Infused Ink is needed. If refined or forged Inkstone comes into contact with a projectile fired from a Mysterious Mushroom, it will turn into Infused Ink.

For the special quest in obtaining a Fusion Coil, an Infused Core is needed. If a Meteor Core comes into contact with a projectile fired from a Mysterious Mushroom, it will turn into an Infused Core.

On other cases with normal trees, the projectile turned them into Corrupted wood - a general wood defined for all trees being hit (not just Mushroom, but every tree. Have tested with Palm tree)

Trivia

  • Prior to the Oaklands map update, players used to be able to use the Grabby Grabber or the Grabbiest Grabber to easily reach the harder-to-reach Mysterious Mushrooms by "grabby-hopping" using a mushroom cap. Grabby-hopping has been removed in the Oaklands Map update, thus this method has become obsolete.
  • The Gravity Coil can be used to retrieve lower-hanging mushrooms. When hit by a mushroom's projectile while holding the Gravity Coil, the anti-gravity effect caused by the projectile becomes much stronger.
  • Refined or planked Mysterious Mushroom wood was the most valuable wood type in the game hitherto the introduction of Magma.
  • Sanded Mysterious Mushroom wood is one of several sources of neon material in the game, alongside sanded Electrified Tree, sanded Magma, all forms of Electrified Bamboo, and forged Uranium.
  • There is a rare glitch whereby the Mysterious Mushrooms can grow from the ground. Due to weird spawning logic (and/or improper value which includes this), the mushrooms can spawn on the ground, flipping over time while growing; they stop when the lowest stem is fully grown. They still can be harvested as normally, only they are hidden inside the ground. This phenomenon can also happen when growing on the ceiling, except it's normal.
  • The Mysterious Mushroom is one of three wood types that aren't made of wood, the other being Mushrooms and Kelp.
  • The Internal Name of the Mysterious Mushroom is called "AlienMushroom," which could be the reason why it glows a neon texture and grows on the ceiling.
  • If the Mysterious Mushroom is hit once, it acts dormant and stops shooting. This can be very useful for grinding Mysterious Mushrooms.
